The Gold Standard of Medical Peeling
The BioRePeel Treatment
BioRePeel is ISAAC Luxe's advanced biphasic peeling treatment — a biostimulating, revitalising, and moisturising peel that works from the inside out to promote cellular turnover and profound skin renewal, with no needles and no downtime.

Thanks to its exfoliating and keratolytic action, BioRePeel promotes cellular turnover by removing the outer corneal layer of skin cells through selective action on corneocyte junction bonds. Its active ingredients stimulate skin replication and biosynthetic processes, helping counterbalance the effects of aging and oxidative damage from UV radiation and pollution.

Biphasic Technology

Lipophilic Phase

Stabilises the formulation, reduces trans-epidermal water evaporation, and restores the skin's natural hydro-lipidic film for lasting hydration.

Hydrophilic Phase

Revitalises skin appearance and gently exfoliates the outer layer of dead skin cells, while its antioxidant action helps reduce fine lines.

Tailored to Every Area
FND & Body Protocols

BioRePeel FND

Face • Neck • Décolleté

1–1.5mL per area, applied every 7–10 days for 4–6 sessions depending on medical evaluation. Exposure time 3–5 minutes according to patient tolerance.

BioRePeel Body

Hands • Elbows • Glutes • Knees • Feet

Dosing tailored by area (1mL for knees/hands up to 6mL for the back), applied every 10–12 days for 4–6 sessions. Exposure time 3–10 minutes according to patient tolerance.

Key Ingredients
Trichloroacetic Acid Lactobionic Acid Salicylic Acid Tartaric & Citric Acid Glycine, Proline & Arginine Vitamins C & B2 Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid Squalane

Who Is This For
Ideal for anyone seeking visible skin renewal without needles or downtime — suitable for all skin types and ages, on the face or body. A consultation will confirm suitability; not recommended during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or with active skin infections.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
